title: wk-cdp-fix-deploy CDP fix deploy launcher
desc: Repo-root wk-* launcher that deploys two CDP fixes for WKAppBot: commits EyeCmdPipeServer.Dispatch.cs fix(eye) (wktasklist exempt-allowlist) then ChromeLauncher.LaunchArgs.cs fix(cdp) (--remote-allow-origins=* for Chrome 149 CDP WebSocket from stash@{4}), pushes origin/main, monitors CI cdp-smoke.yml in kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk up to 20 min, resolves both suggests on green. Mapping skill so the wk-tool first-use nudge resolves; invoke via ./wk-cdp-fix-deploy.cmd (repo root, not on PATH so bare name fails).
steps: INVOKE via the relative path ./wk-cdp-fix-deploy.cmd from repo root D:/GitHub/WKAppBot -- the bare name is NOT on PATH (exit 127); the path form is wk-prefixed so it stays pace-exempt.

It commits Dispatch.cs (fix(eye) wktasklist allowlist) and LaunchArgs.cs (fix(cdp) --remote-allow-origins=* extracted from git stash@{4}), pushes, then polls CI cdp-smoke.yml in kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk for 20 minutes (Poll N/20, 60s each).

On CI green it resolves suggest 2026-06-24T00:04:01 (wktasklist exempt) and 1782393412 (chrome-remote-allow-origins) with --commit HASH --class CdpClient. Those resolves omit --i-completed-script/--skill so they may be rejected by the resolve guards -- expected, report rejection verbatim.
Runs ~20 min in the CI poll loop; launch in background.
author: claude
